name: Golden Lotus Grand Da Nang
detail: An absolute 10/10 experience, Golden Lotus Grand Da Nang exceeds every expectation with its unbeatable location just a short stroll from My Khe Beach, luxurious and spotlessly clean rooms featuring private balconies, and breathtaking rooftop infinity pool views. From the rich breakfast buffet showcasing authentic Vietnamese specialties to the charming daily afternoon tea and genuinely warm, attentive staff who make you feel at home from start to finish, every single detail creates an unforgettable, five-star stay that I cannot recommend highly enough!

name: Grandvrio Ocean Resort Danang
detail: It was a very good vacation. The room was clean and spacious, and I could relax very well. Additionally, all the staff were very kind, and having a Japanese manager on site, along with some local staff who could speak Japanese, made me feel very安心 (at ease). The staff in the lobby were always attentive, so I could casually consult them about sightseeing and dining. The breakfast menu was diverse, and I was happy to see miso soup and tempura available. I also used it for lunch, and the banh mi was very delicious. Unfortunately, since it was raining continuously, I couldn't use the pool, but the public bath was clean and very nice. It's about a 30-minute distance from the airport, which is perfect for spending time more leisurely rather than strolling through the city. On the other hand, it was nice that Hoi An is just 20 minutes away and the Marble Mountains are about 10 minutes away, making sightseeing easily accessible. Although I didn't use it due to time constraints, it seemed that there was a shuttle bus from the hotel, so I had no trouble moving around. I received pleasant service until the end, making it a very good vacation. If you are looking for accommodations in Da Nang, I highly recommend it.
area: Hòa Hải,Da Nang - View on map

name: Radisson Hotel Danang
detail: It's clean and friendly, the shower pressure is strong, and the breakfast is decent. I read reviews saying it was noisy, but I didn't notice it at all. In fact, if the sound of cars honking was loud, it would be even louder. There's also a massage shop in the hotel, and I received a good massage there. I didn't swim, but the pool is big and beautiful. It seems like a hotel worth recommending.
area: Phước Mỹ,Da Nang - View on map

name: Sujet Beach Hotel Da Nang by Haviland
detail: I stayed for 5 nights at the end of the year and had a comfortable time. It was nice to enjoy beach walks since Mike Beach was nearby, and there were also nearby restaurants and markets, so there was no inconvenience. The room was spacious and clean, and the bedding was comfortable, so I slept well every day. I appreciated the staff for their friendly welcome and quick response to my requests. It was a great value accommodation, and I would like to use it again next time.
area: An Hai Bac,Da Nang - View on map

name: The Memory Danang Boutique
detail: Being my first solo trip, I was feeling homesick, and the staff were very attentive to that. When I requested an extension for my room stay, they responded quickly. The hotel is located in an area with a lot of traffic, so there are times when outside noise can be bothersome. I recommend bringing earplugs. The beach is about an 8-minute walk, and there are many cafes, spas, and shops nearby. The breakfast was also delicious! Thank you for a wonderful time.
area: Phước Mỹ,Da Nang - View on map

name: Diamond Sea Hotel
detail: The location is right by the beach and there is a convenience store next door, making it very convenient. The room was clean and comfortable. The breakfast buffet was very delicious. The staff were very friendly and accommodating with various requests. There were some issues like the hot water not working and water leaking from the air conditioner, but they fixed them quickly. It was a beachfront room, but directly below the room is a main road, so there is quite a bit of traffic noise. We were happy to have a view of the ocean and didn't mind it much, but for those who prefer a quiet environment, it might be a good idea to request that in advance.
area: Phước Mỹ,Da Nang - View on map

name: Seahorse Signature Danang Hotel By Sujet of Haviland
detail: There is a wide choice of delicious breakfast foods, including fresh juice. The room was amazing, and the shower water pressure was strong enough. You can also enjoy sunbathing at the rooftop pool. They offer a laundry service for 40,000 VND per kilogram; I dropped mine off by 10 PM and picked it up around 10 AM the next morning. The location is super convenient, making it easy to get anywhere. Thao customer service Thao Linh Nhung Sinh staff are great.
area: Hải Châu,Da Nang - View on map

name: Muong Thanh Luxury Da Nang hotel
detail: *Accessibility It was very close to the airport. There were a lot of CCCP and marts around, which was really nice. *Room The ocean view was fantastic. It was so great that it offset all the other shortcomings. Some reviews mentioned bugs in the rooms, but we didn't see any at all, and the cleaning was neat. The only downside was that the air conditioning didn't cool down quickly. The outside weather was too humid, so we wanted to be cool when we came in, but it took some time to get comfortable. *Food I usually make a point to have hotel breakfast when I travel, but the breakfast here was somewhat disappointing. There wasn't much variety, and the absence of carbonated drinks was a letdown. There was something like watermelon tea, but it didn't taste good. *Facilities I didn't check out other places, but there is a lounge bar on the 40th floor that you really must visit. It had an unprecedented view of My Khe Beach and Da Nang city. Cocktails were reasonably priced, and there weren't many people since it seems like not many know about it, so we used it comfortably and took a lot of pictures. This place is really amazing. Additionally, there were quite a few bars and restaurants right in front of the beach, making it nice to stop by for dinner before heading back. Grab cars were also easily available, and the staff were friendly, among other things. It was a hotel with many advantages. I would definitely consider revisiting next time. I had a great stay.

name: Crystal Hotel
detail: The room is spacious and beautiful, close to My Khe beach. I chose a room that doesn’t include breakfast, it’s affordable and I got a family room, clean and fully equipped, we didn’t even use all the beds.

name: Dylan Hotel Danang
detail: Close to the beach, surrounded by many local restaurants, convenient for traveling to other attractions. The hotel has a prime location, good. The rooms are spacious, beautiful, fully equipped, friendly staff, and there is a very nice rooftop pool, reasonably priced.
